[8H6M69W4]: No. 15668 reports the title "dbu ma'i yig cha" and the author "rigs pa smra ba'i dge slong chos kyi seng ge." 
The 82-folio manuscript with the signature "tsa 107" reported in [HMSTSJ7Q]: 71, with the colophon corresponding to that of the dBu ma snang ba'i 'grel pa (ID:4882) might correspond to this instance, or to instance (ID:4481), which bears the title "dbu ma'i yig cha" on its cover page.
